evidence.label: def:p02-w02-p02-036-fagin-encoding
evidence.shows: Finite encoding: Fagin's word e(A)=a#b_1#...#b_r over {0,1,#} (binary n; characteristic words in lexicographic tuple order) and E(A), with r>=1. Shift from [n] to {1,...,n}. Isomorphism closure makes membership independent of the listing order. The empty-tau case (NP_1) is excluded. The P4 variant format is cross-referenced.

evidence.label: thm:p03-fagin
evidence.shows: Statement: for tau with at least one relation symbol, an isomorphism-closed class A of finite tau-structures has E(A) in NP iff A is the class of finite models of an ESO tau-sentence. Status cited=Fagin1974.

evidence.label: thm:p03-fagin
evidence.shows: Order conventions: no built-in order on inputs; the only order is the word's listing, neutralized by isomorphism closure; the NP->ESO direction guesses a linear order with least/greatest elements and successor, lexicographic tableau coordinates; the ESO->NP direction guesses polynomial-size tables. Contrast with ordered LFP capture.
